testResults.name: focused-screening-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/screening/
testResults.result: 22 tests: strict no-lookahead (a post-as_of bar with an enormous dollar volume is invisible and cannot change ranking), deterministic rank with symbol-ascending tiebreak and byte-identical repeat runs, provenance on every result (universe revision, data window, definition hash), preset evaluation and conjunction (dollar-volume floor, price floor, listing age, candidate-set percentile rank), declaration-time parameter validation, the programmatic boundary (exactly one screen(ctx) function, allowlisted imports only, no aliases, no dunder access, restricted builtins with a blocked __import__, open() and __import__('os') failing closed at runtime), fail-closed script errors, and artifact round-trip with content-hash verification and tamper rejection

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2462 passed, 15 skipped, 1 xfailed at wave edit freeze

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/thesis/screening tests/thesis/screening && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check src/thesis/screening tests/thesis/screening && uv run --extra dev ty check src/thesis/screening

limitations: The screener engine consumes injected ScreenerContext ports; the Thesis API route wiring that feeds it from the lake and universe services is the integration owner's next step (recommended: POST /v1/workspaces/{ws}/screeners/run and GET /v1/workspaces/{ws}/screeners)
